contracts.name: identity.user_registered.v1
contracts.notes: Customer creates its own profile projection from this durable identity fact.

contracts.name: identity.user_registered.v2
contracts.notes: Phone-only customer registration after successful OTP verification. Raw OTP values never enter Kafka.

contracts.name: identity.auth.v1
contracts.notes: Public customer OTP and staff password authentication endpoints. Internal OTP delivery retrieval is intentionally excluded.

contracts.name: customer.profile.v1
contracts.notes: Customer-owned contact profile API. The contact email is not an Identity credential and is required for checkout invoice email.

contracts.name: order.query.v1
contracts.notes: Customer-owned order history and administrator-only fulfillment and refund-request operations.

contracts.name: order.checkout.v1
contracts.notes: Customer checkout commands, including the Cart-backed one-step Zarinpal redirect path.

contracts.name: payment.zarinpal.v1
contracts.notes: Customer payment-start API and verified Zarinpal browser-return callback. Zarinpal reversal is started only from Order's durable administrator refund request.

contracts.name: search.query.v1
contracts.notes: Public search of the eventually consistent Catalog projection; it never exposes draft products or canonical Catalog writes.

contracts.name: catalog.products.v1
contracts.notes: Public cursor-paginated listing of canonical published Catalog products.

contracts.name: media.catalog_attachment.v1
contracts.notes: Internal, HMAC-authenticated readiness and ownership validation before Catalog persists an opaque product-image reference.

contracts.name: kafka.dead_letter.v1
contracts.notes: Technical Kafka processing failures only. The original record is preserved as base64 bytes together with source coordinates and local retry history.

contracts.name: chat.v1
contracts.notes: Bidirectional WebSocket client protocol. Sender acknowledgements follow the local Chat PostgreSQL commit; messages may be duplicated across reconnect or Redis fan-out and are deduplicated by message_id.

contracts.name: chat.support.v1
contracts.notes: Customer support queue creation, metadata-only administrator queue listing, atomic claim, release, and close operations. The assigned administrator becomes the only administrator participant.

contracts.name: order.created.v1
contracts.notes: Checkout workflow key is order_id.

contracts.name: inventory.reserved.v1
contracts.notes: Checkout workflow key is order_id.

contracts.name: inventory.reservation_failed.v1
contracts.notes: Checkout workflow key is order_id.

contracts.name: payment.processing.v1
contracts.notes: Payment accepted the reservation and opened its local payment workflow.

contracts.name: payment.succeeded.v1
contracts.notes: Checkout workflow key is order_id.

contracts.name: payment.failed.v1
contracts.notes: Checkout workflow key is order_id.

contracts.name: payment.refunded.v1
contracts.notes: Payment completed a Zarinpal reversal for the durable Order refund request.

contracts.name: payment.refund_failed.v1
contracts.notes: Payment rejected the durable Order refund request before a reversal completed.

contracts.name: order.confirmed.v1
contracts.notes: Order is terminally confirmed. An independent Order consumer group creates the durable invoice-generation handoff.

contracts.name: order.refund_requested.v1
contracts.notes: Administrator requested a provider-owned reversal while the Order was still confirmed.

contracts.name: order.fulfillment_updated.v1
contracts.notes: Administrator advanced a paid order through fulfillment; this is retained for future projections.

contracts.name: invoice.generated.v1
contracts.notes: Invoice bytes remain Order-owned object storage data; Notification receives only the delivery fact and recipient contact snapshot.
